fields.label: Model Backend
fields.description: Default uses the normal built-in edit fields. Workflow uses the Agent Flow native staged graph for this model.

fields.label: Execution mode
fields.description: Use built-in video routing by default, or switch to a fully custom command template.

fields.label: Model workflow mode
fields.description: For tested workflow profiles, use the node-based workflow model loader by default. Legacy checkpoint runner keeps the older all-in-one path.

fields.label: Workflow node lifecycle
fields.description: Controls resource behavior for workflow-model-loader nodes.

fields.label: Workflow execution backend
fields.description: Selects how workflow model nodes execute. Native graph runs each node stage; legacy checkpoint runner runs the older all-in-one process.

fields.label: Workflow node timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time allowed for a terminal workflow execution node.

fields.label: ComfyUI runtime root
fields.description: Optional path to a full ComfyUI checkout. Needed for the native ComfyUI-GGUF backend because the GGUF custom node imports comfy.*, nodes, and folder_paths.

fields.label: ComfyUI-GGUF vendor root
fields.description: Path to the vendored ComfyUI-GGUF custom node code.

fields.label: Template preset
fields.description: Prefills example JSON for custom video generation commands.

fields.label: Custom command template JSON
fields.description: Advanced mode only. Full argv template for your external video generator.

fields.label: Custom asset JSON
fields.description: Advanced mode only. Paths or static assets referenced by the template.

fields.label: Custom parameter JSON
fields.description: Advanced mode only. Optional defaults merged into the runtime template placeholders.

fields.label: Custom extra args
fields.description: Advanced mode only. Extra args appended after the rendered command template.

fields.label: Pipeline class name
fields.description: Auto-filled from the matched tested profile when known. Leave blank to use the profile default.

fields.label: Transformer class name
fields.description: Auto-filled from the matched tested profile when known. Leave blank to use the profile default.

fields.label: Gemma text encoding device
fields.description: For native Unsloth LTX workflows, choose where the Gemma prompt encoder runs. CPU is the safer default for now.

fields.label: Gemma max prompt tokens
fields.description: Maximum tokens sent through the Gemma prompt encoder for native LTX workflows. Lower values reduce memory and speed up prompt encoding; use 1024 only for very long prompts.

fields.label: Allow legacy eager Gemma GPU load
fields.description: Diagnostic fallback only. Leave off for lazy GGUF module loading, which keeps packed GGUF weights compact and dequantizes per layer.

choices.label: Legacy LTX dense block streaming (disk slots)
Legacy LTX dense block streaming (CPU slots)

fields.label: Transformer offload mode
fields.description: For native workflow GGUF models, lazy quantized modules keep packed GGUF tensors compact and dequantize per layer. Legacy block streaming expands dense block slots and should only be used for diagnostics.

fields.label: Native GGUF execution mode
fields.description: Controls GGUF transformer residency. Lazy quantized keeps packed GGUF tensors compact and dequantizes per layer. Full VRAM eager dequantizes/materializes weights on the main device for speed, but can use much more VRAM. Legacy block streaming is a diagnostic fallback.

choices.label: Main GPU / XPU packed GGUF cache (Recommended)

fields.label: Lazy GGUF packed tensor residency
fields.description: For lazy quantized GGUF execution, choose where the compact packed GGUF tensors live. GPU/XPU keeps the same on-the-fly layer dequantization path but avoids repeatedly paging packed weights through system RAM. CPU is safer if VRAM is tight.

fields.label: Video-only sampling
fields.description: For MP4-only generation, skip the AVTransformer audio sampling branch to reduce RAM and runtime. Turn off only when you intentionally want full AV conditioning/audio-path testing.
